verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents managed databases on a shared pool or dedicated compute, chosen per database as serverless or dedicated. It offers relational tables with typed columns and indexes, managed APIs with permissions and realtime, and a native PostgreSQL option. The CLI can generate a type-safe SDK from the database schema, which implies SDK-based reads and writes. Missing for 10: explicit first-party evidence of row read/write calls from both client and server SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
